rows.text:
Confiscated from the Sparxie Fan Club's unauthorized late-night gathering.

Date of Confiscation: ███ ██
Confiscated Item: Sparkle Plushie 
Reason for Confiscation: Three second-year students and five first-year students formed an unauthorized club called "Sparxie Fan Club" and held an unsanctioned gathering in the gymnasium late at night. Club members wore bizarre costumes, waved glow sticks, and chanted "Destroy the old model" and "Sparxicle forever," all while surrounding the doll. The continuous noise resulted in a night patrol teacher suffering a sudden seizure and requiring emergency medical attention.
Disposal Method: Stored in the archive room, to be returned upon graduation.
